title: Document Bahtinov mask focusing in the Imager Agent
description: Create indigo_drivers/agent_imager/doc/BAHTINOV.md in English using the established technical reference format and header. Explain the optical origin of the three diffraction spikes and the focus criterion. Trace the actual indigo_libs/indigo_bahtinov.c analysis pipeline from supported pixels to measured spike lines, outer-line intersection and signed pixel error, including known/free mask angles, confidence and rejection. Explain what the Imager Agent learns, displays and uses to drive iterative autofocus. Document concrete implementation and practical optical limitations, supported frames, failure behavior and interpretation of the sign/units. Link source and existing tests, distinguishing tested behavior from practical guidance. Verify against the current implementation and documentation links. Documentation only.

outcome.summary: Independent review of snapshot 839bc15452: no actionable defects. Verified the complete Bahtinov guide against analyzer/header constants and control flow, Imager angle learning/fallback, frame gate, published coordinates and error, iterative quality selection/reversals/travel/failure/recovery, and the actual assertions in 12 synthetic library cases plus both cited agent integration cases. The optical description agrees with the primary stac845 article text accessible through indexed publisher content (direct publisher fetch was unavailable). Reviewed contextual tuning-guide corrections and Xcode group registration. Independently verified 27 local links/anchors in BAHTINOV.md, its whitespace/fences, plutil Xcode syntax and git diff --check. Production source is unchanged; this documentation review did not run simulator, hardware or runtime tests, and makes no hardware-accuracy claim.
